overview_description.description: NanoCorp provides an artificial intelligence platform for creating and operating autonomous digital businesses from a single text prompt. The platform uses specialized AI agents to write and deploy application code, configure public landing pages, and set up Stripe-based billing pipelines. It automates customer communication routing and generates marketing strategies for the businesses it creates. NanoCorp also manages Google Search Ads on behalf of these businesses, handling ad copy, keyword selection, and optimization. Users monitor their portfolio of AI-run companies and agents through a unified dashboard that tracks real-time actions and customer revenues. The service is designed for individuals and entrepreneurs who want to launch and manage multiple online businesses with minimal manual oversight.
